meta.title: SunmoonAI Admin
meta.description: A production Next.js administration foundation paired with a dedicated FastAPI Admin Backend.

public.title: A secure and auditable governance console foundation
public.description: Identity, authorization, session, data access and release boundaries are governed by explicit contracts.

acceptance.done: This version has its acceptance; see the right.
acceptance.trial: accepted automatically in the trial period

q.steps: What are the steps, and the rule for judging each?
q.correctness: How do you know it is right?

knowbots.bindingsHint: Write the manifest's data_bindings like this:

hatch.title: Incubation
hatch.pick: Which idea version to incubate (accepted ones only)
hatch.manual: Manual incubation: paste the expert manifest
hatch.hint: Only manual incubation for now: write the manifest elsewhere, paste it here, and it is checked and incubated. Rule sources may cite only sentences of this idea version; the x.y number is set by the backend.
hatch.noAccepted: This name has no accepted idea version yet.

incubation.reviewWaiting: Asked the user to review on {at}; waiting for an answer.
incubation.reviewNotOk: The user said no: {note}. Incubate again.

knowbots.reviewHint: Every rule must trace back to the user's own words in this idea version (C-L1). Read the rule sources on the right before pressing.
knowbots.review: Rule sources checked one by one

blocked.test_running: A test of this name is running; wait for it to end.

tests.meta: started {at} by {who} · budget {budget} CNY · timeout {timeout} s
tests.backfilled: Earlier tests left no record (before 0012 a retest of the same candidate overwrote the last one).
tests.waiting: Stopped where a person has to decide; waiting for an answer.

ended.failed: Not passed: see the results and outputs on the right, then incubate again.
ended.platform_error: Platform error; this test is over. The candidate is back to be tested, and a retest gets a new number.

knowbots.startHint: The budget is split evenly across cases; the timeout is shared by all cases of the test, and time waiting for answers does not count.
knowbots.acceptedWaiting: Accepted, not started: waiting for the test computer to pick it up
knowbots.blockedOffline: Accepted, not started: the test computer is offline
knowbots.blockedFolder: Accepted, not started: the test computer has not given a clean folder yet
knowbots.testingHint: After a refresh, the line above shows which case and step it is on; a row appears in the results on the right once a case finishes. If it is past its time with no result, end it as stuck.
knowbots.queuedLine: {case} ({done}/{total}) is queued behind the test account's previous job

delivery.returnHint: Return: the user gets an item in Review on the web, reads the write-ups and results, and decides whether to take it.
delivery.awaitingUser: Returned; waiting for the user to decide.
delivery.reviewHint: Operator review: the write-up carries no target prices or ratings (C-L5), and the acceptance matches the test results. Public needs a qualified publisher (reviewed in knowmart); otherwise it stays private.
delivery.backfillReview: Listed in the trial period: review it once. Approving only records the review (no new delivery); rejecting stops this version.
delivery.backfillRejectedNotStopped: The review rejected it but stopping did not work; retry stopping below.
delivery.stopHint: Stop: the knowmart version stops too; nobody can ask it any more, runs already going finish.

listingStatus.pending: Waiting for listing review in knowmart
listingStatus.category_needed: Kept private: the seller has not chosen a category in knowmart yet
listingStatus.not_qualified: Kept private: the seller's publisher or category license is not approved yet

event.reviewRequested: Incubation: asked the user to review candidate {label}
event.reviewOk: Review: the user said candidate {label} is fine
event.reviewNotOk: Review: the user said no to candidate {label}
event.returned: Return: expert version {version} sent to the user

amendments.title: Amendments the user wrote earlier (SDD 0035, retired): kept as history, sources still traceable. From now on a change of method is a new idea version.

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.intro: Pick a version of an idea and write its acceptance after three checks: not investment advice (C-L5), the test data may be used (C-L2), within what this kind of expert does (C-L1).

incubation.title: Incubation
incubation.intro: Pick an accepted idea version and paste a manifest to incubate a candidate; you may ask the user to review it. Only candidates with checked rule sources go to testing.

tests.title: Tests
tests.intro: Run a candidate with checked rule sources through its cases; every run gets a new number. Platform errors are retested on the same candidate; a pass makes an expert.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: Return to the user → the user takes it → operator review → deliver to knowmart. Listed versions can be stopped; All experts lists every version of every name.

name.title: Name
name.intro: The life of one name: the latest of each process, and the record in time order.

outputs.title: Write-ups and step outputs
outputs.none: This test brought back no outputs.
outputs.truncated: The write-up is long; only the first part is shown.
outputs.omitted: Output too large to bring back ({bytes} bytes)
outputs.rejectedNoCheck: The reply was not valid JSON, so no check ran.
outputs.notYet: Not fetched yet: press “Fetch outputs again”.
outputs.consentNeeded: This idea was submitted under the old test-data notice: outputs are neither fetched nor shown until the user accepts the new notice on the web.

questions.title: Questions to answer
questions.intro: The test stopped where a person has to decide; it continues once answered. We answer approvals; questions and ask-before prompts go to the user first (C-L1). If one is only about how to run, say why in one line and answer it ourselves; our answers are not the user's confirmation and are not remembered as answered prompts or put into the rule sources.
questions.withUser: With the user, waiting for an answer.
questions.judgementHint: Anything that is an investment judgement (basis, trade-off, threshold) goes back to the user.
questions.takeReason: Why this is only about how to run (one line)

side.resize: Drag to resize (arrow keys work too)
